body:
Pure XTC
First of all, I just mostly smoke weed. I don't do alot of drugs. So I came across some oxycodone pills, the white 5mg ones. The pills were round, and had an M on the front in a square box, and on the back said 05 52, and they had a line between 05 and 52. I sold most of them, and just gave some to my friends. Anyways, I was suppose to go out to a party, but it got cancelled so I just chilled at home. I thought of the oxy pills, and I didn't have much weed, so I decided to take them. It was my first time and everyone in the house was asleep downstairs, so I wouldn't have to worry about that. I also decided to keep my computer on , and to randomly type the feelings I'd experience just in case I would forget the next day, and I described the feelings as best as I could.
10:35pm
T+00:00- dropped 4, 5mg oxydone pills (20mg total). Just relaxed, and watched some tv. I didn't notice any changes for some time, I kept wondering when it was going to kick in, but I knew to keep a relaxed mood.
10:52pm
T+00:17 min.- Feeling light effects of euphoria, like everything is peaceful. Slight reduction in inhibitions. Body temperature rose very little. I put the fans and ac on, and made up the bed just in case I needed to crash.
11:00pm
T+00:25min.- Stronger feelings of peace, I want to go and chill instead of typing my experience. Don't feel like talking on AIM anymore (but I would talk in person). Everything is just kind of dreamy, but I don't feel intoxicated. It's like a very conscious dreamy and peaceful high.
I don't feel intoxicated. It's like a very conscious dreamy and peaceful high.
11:05pm
T+00:30min.- Feeling onset of stonger and more effects, definitely feel more peaceful, very smiley, very friendly ( I was on AIM on and off). Trails in vision if I move too fast. More of that peaceful non-intoxicated dream state. I go and watch tv, I have a way more positive outlook on things.
11:20pm
T+00:45min.- More body high now, just really soothing and relaxed. No worries, feeling fine, really really peaceful. Not really that strong effects like I expected. I go and play some Driver 3, I can't drive at all, I keep crashing at intersections LoL. I decide that I wanna finish the last of my weed, so I hit it out of a gravity bong, that really boosts my high later on.
11:48pm
T+1:13min- Strong body high. Definitely peaking, techno music sounds sooo good (usually just like rap), Finished smoking weed. Strong visual high, I can see so well, everything on the computer and tv look way more 3D. I love everyone and everything, feels like a low dose of XTC (never tried it just know what it suppose to feel like). Soooo peaceful. Almost too strong, but that's only if I panic, as long as I know I took a safe amount I'm safe. Just enjoy the feelings.
12:35am
T+2:00- Not peaking anymore but still really high. (was scared of OD'ing at peak but feeling fine). Very slow come down, still very peaceful and dream state.
1:35am
T+3:00 Still pretty high, like I said slow come down. Same feelings just not as strong, visuals went away. Probably gonna go to sleep at 2:00am (even though I'm still really awake) and just ride it out until then.
Conclusion:
Total pills: 4
Type: Oxycodone immeadiate release
Milligrams: 20
Onset of feelings: T+ about 30 min
Peak onset: T+ about 50-60min.
Peak: T+ 1hr 10-15min.
Peak duration: about an hour
Comedown: very slow and peaceful
Total duration: about 3 hours
Exp Year: 2007
ExpID: 62971
Gender: Male
Age at time of experience: Not Given
